title: Define Distribution Alpha entry criteria from runtime foundation
purpose: Create the handoff contract that blocks AgentOS distribution work until the bottom Agent runtime and security substrate are real.
scope: Define Distribution Alpha prerequisites from AgentCore and SEF completion.
Mark generic Agent run loop as required before VM image factory work.
Define which runtime artifacts must be installed into future rootfs: agentd, policy pack, tool manifest, run-state directory, audit directory, rollback directory, and model broker config.
Define QEMU E2E gates that Distribution Alpha must inherit.
Update TASK.md with the runtime-foundation-to-distribution bridge.
acceptance_criteria: Distribution Alpha cannot start from only the MVP skeleton.
Entry criteria explicitly require generic service recovery through AgentCore.
Entry criteria explicitly require runtime safety gates.
Entry criteria specify persistent runtime directories and release artifacts.
verification: Review future Distribution Alpha task dependencies.
Confirm runtime foundation final audit is listed as a prerequisite.
risk_notes: Without this bridge, distro work can produce a bootable image that lacks a real agent runtime.
